title: CookieAnnouncements
body:
# CookieAnnouncements

A Paper plugin for broadcasting custom announcements with sound effects.

## Features

- Multiple command aliases: `/announce`, `/announcement`, `/bc`, `/broadcast`
- Customizable multiline announcement format
- Configurable sound effects
- Permission-based access control
- Reload configuration without restarting

## Commands

- `/announce <message>` - Broadcast an announcement
- `/announcement <message>` - Alias for /announce
- `/bc <message>` - Alias for /announce
- `/broadcast <message>` - Alias for /announce
- `/cookieannounce reload` - Reload the configuration

## Permissions

- `cookieannounce.use` - Required to use announcement commands (default: op)
- `cookieannounce.reload` - Required to reload configuration (default: op)

## Configuration

Edit `config.yml` to customize:
- Announcement message format (supports color codes with `&`)
- Sound effects (name, volume, pitch)
- Custom messages
